description: This file implements the main activity of an Android application using Kotlin. It defines a MainActivity class that extends ComponentActivity, sets up a ViewModel for task management, and uses Jetpack Compose for UI rendering.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class that initializes and displays the task list UI, manages the ViewModel for task data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI with Compose by applying the app theme and displaying the task list screen.
